title: Padded regular multigraph
statement: Let $r$ be a symmetric relation on the finite vertex set $0,\\ldots,n-1$, and let $D$ be a natural number with $n\\le D$. The padded regular multigraph has degree $D$ and assigns to each vertex and each of its $D$ edge slots the padded neighbor; its edge multiplicities are symmetric.
hypotheses_covered: A symmetric relation r on Fin n with decidable membership
